verdict.rationale: ESD documents a mail rail for quarterly tax and wage reports and will mail paper forms on request. It also publishes an amended tax and wage report form (PDF) that can be submitted by email, mail or fax. However, the evidence never shows the actual mailing addresses or fax numbers, so the 'exact' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: exact mailing addresses, fax numbers, a downloadable original quarterly report form (not just the amended one), and hands-on confirmation that the paper rail works.
